description: This file is a shell script used for remote feature control in a set-top box environment. It manages configuration updates, communicates with a remote server, processes JSON responses, and schedules periodic execution via cron. It includes functions for logging, HTTP requests, JSON processing, and system configuration adjustments.

methods.name: rfcLogging
methods.description: Logs messages to the RFC log file, with different formatting based on device type.

methods.name: sendHttpRequestToServer
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the server, handles response, and processes JSON data.

methods.name: CallXconf
methods.description: Main function to initiate configuration fetch from remote server, with retry logic.

methods.name: waitForIpAcquisition
methods.description: Waits until the device obtains a valid IP address, supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: parseConfigValue
methods.description: Uses dmcli to get and set configuration parameters based on JSON input.

methods.name: processJsonResponseV
methods.description: Processes JSON response for version 2, updates configuration variables.

methods.name: processJsonResponseB
methods.description: Processes JSON response for broadband devices, using dcmjsonparser.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Returns the build type (e.g., prod, dev).

methods.name: getChannelMapId
methods.description: Returns a fixed channel map ID.

methods.name: IsDirectBlocked
methods.description: Checks if direct communication is blocked based on a lock file timestamp.

methods.name: getRequestType
methods.description: Determines request type based on domain name.

methods.name: getECMMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the ECM MAC address, formatted without spaces or quotes.
